title: Here’s How to Watch ‘Southern Charm’ Season 12 Online for Free
summary: The new season premieres on Bravo starting Thursday, Nov. 12 — watch online for free.

Southern Charm returns for season 12 with more South Carolina drama, twisted relationships and so many secrets to unravel. Fan favorites Conover, Rose, Kroll, Aspen, LeCroy, Reyes, Carson, O’Connell and others return, while new cast members join in 2026. The drama begins on Thursday (Nov. 12).

- Date: Starting on Thursday, Nov. 12

The reality TV series airs on cable network Bravo at 9 p.m. ET/PT.

How to Watch ‘Southern Charm’ Season 12 Online for Free

In order to watch Southern Charm , you’ll need to have access to Bravo. There are a few ways to watch online for free, including getting a subscription to Philo .

Sling TV

Get Sling Blue

Sling Blue

A subscription to Sling Blue , which comes with Bravo for Southern Charm and goes for $54.99 per month, gets you access to live TV. You can also watch local networks, such as NBC, ABC and FOX (all in select markets), while you can watch many cable networks too. Please note: Pricing and channel availability vary on TV market. Learn more about Sling TV here .

Hulu + Live TV

Get 3-day free trial

Hulu + Live TV comes with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Select at no additional cost.

If you don’t have a  Hulu + Live TV subscription , the streamer offers a free trial that’ll get you your first three days free to access Bravo. Once the free trial is over, you’ll be charged the regular subscription fee, which starts at $99.99 per month. For even more content, Hulu + Live TV bundles with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Select at no extra cost to watch even more exclusive and original sporting events and programming.

Peacock

Get Peacock Premium

The official Bravo streamer.

There are two different plans offered on Peacock: The Premium Plan for $12.99 per month or the Premium Plus Plan for $19.99 per month. If you’re looking to save, you can get 17% off when you choose the annual plan for $129.99 per year or $199.99 per year, respectively. With the Premium Plan, it’s ad-supported and you’ll receive access to a wide range of movies, TV shows, originals, live sports from NBC Sports and live news from NBC News.

Peacock’s Premium Plus plan comes with everything in the Premium plan , no ads, your local NBC channel live and the ability to download and stream offline.

Alongside Southern Charm , offers a number of music documentaries and specials, such as Toby Keith: An American Icon , Bowie: The Man Who Changed The World , Bob Dylan: The Folk Years , Stevie Nicks: Through The Looking Glass , Katy Perry: Main Square , Welcome To The A: 50 Years of Hip-Hop in Atlanta and more.

Season 12 of Southern Charm is available to stream on DirecTV , Philo or Peacock starting on Thursday (Nov. 12), starting at 9 p.m. ET/PT.
